name: 贪食鼹
evolution: 伏地兽 → 贪食鼹 Lv.20 → 巨噬针鼹 Lv.32
description: 吻部变得坚硬，形状如同吸管，舌头又长又黏。没有嗅觉器官，通过舌头来感知气味，经常舔舐各种味道刺激的东西。
descriptionEn: Its snout has hardened into the shape of a straw, and its tongue is long and sticky. It has no organs of smell and senses scents through its tongue, often licking strongly flavored things for stimulation.

skills.name: 抓挠
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage and restores 1 energy to itself.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%. Counters attacks.

skills.name: 三连破
skills.descriptionEn: Gains +30% physical attack and hits 3 times.

skills.name: 当头棒喝
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能威力+100。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. If the opponent switches creature this turn, this skill's power +100.

skills.name: 乘胜追击
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，每次使用后，本技能连击数永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage with 1 hit. After each use, this skill's combo count permanently +1.

skills.name: 摇篮曲
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能能耗+3，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: All of the enemy's skills cost +3 energy. Counters defense: additionally interrupts, and the enemy becomes stunned next turn.

skills.name: 吞噬
skills.description: 造成物伤，若使用本技能击败敌方，回复6能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. If this skill defeats the enemy, restores 6 energy.

skills.name: 连续爪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，应对状态：本次技能连击数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage with 2 hits. Counters status: this skill's combo count is doubled.

skills.name: 阻断
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. Counters status: additionally interrupts the countered skill.

skills.name: 偷袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. Counters status: this skill's power becomes 3 times.
